headline: Operational Disruption at Primary Optical Component Supplier
content: On October 17, 2023, Apple Inc. was notified that FabCo Semiconductor, our sole source supplier of specialized optical transceivers utilized across our flagship hardware product lines, experienced a catastrophic facility disruption resulting in an emergency shutdown of its primary fabrication line. Management currently estimates a disruption duration of 90 days. While Apple maintains an active inventory buffer of approximately 45 days for critical components, the shortfall is expected to delay fourth-quarter production yields unless secondary capacity is qualified. This occurrence constitutes a Material Adverse Effect under Section 8.01 of the Master Component Supply Agreement.
